description: Ordinary-assertion probes for the public PrintExtents planned-extrusion contract.

mutants.description: Discard ExtrusionMultiPath half-width inflation. The fixture uses distinct 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0 mm planned widths and exact projected bounds, so the ordinary bounding-box assertions should fail.
Drop the public PrintInstance shift when merging each copy. The two copies are placed at (20,30) and (60,80), and the expected union bounds should fail as an ordinary assertion.
Make the layer cutoff exclusive at equality. The lower layer at print_z 0.2 is explicitly checked at cutoff 0.2, while 0.399 excludes the upper 0.4 layer; the equality row should fail.
